component.name: Tadpole
component.summary: Audit websites and explore their internal links

description.p: Tadpole is a desktop SEO crawler for inspecting website structure, metadata, indexability and internal links.
Explore crawled pages using directory, link and rank visualizations, and export audit data. Optional AI metadata suggestions require your own provider API key.
Compare XML and gzip sitemaps with observed internal links, inspect candidate orphan pages and sitemap response or indexability findings, and save or export discovery evidence with crawl coverage.
Inspect links in wrapping tables with anchors and targets, preview images with resolution and alt text, and review richer Open Graph and Twitter cards.
